title: Italian Aubergine, Tomato and Mozzarella Bake
summary: A comforting layered vegetarian bake of tender aubergine, rich tomato sauce and melting mozzarella, inspired by melanzane alla parmigiana. It is ideal for a cosy dinner with salad or crusty bread on the side.

ingredients.name: aubergines, sliced lengthways into 1 cm slices

steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C. Lay the aubergine slices on two baking trays, brush with 3 tbsp of the olive oil and season with about half the salt and pepper. Roast for 20–25 minutes, turning once, until softened and lightly golden at the edges.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 6–8 minutes until soft and translucent.

Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Stir in the tomato paste, canned tomatoes and dried oregano. Simmer uncovered for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened into a rich sauce. Stir in most of the basil and season with the remaining salt and pepper.

Reduce the oven to 200°C. Spoon a thin layer of tomato sauce into a baking dish, then add a layer of roasted aubergine, followed by mozzarella slices and a little parmesan. Repeat the layers, finishing with tomato sauce, mozzarella and parmesan on top.
Scatter the breadcrumbs over the top. Bake for 25–30 minutes until bubbling, golden and the mozzarella is melted with browned spots.
Leave the bake to stand for 10 minutes so the layers settle, then finish with the remaining basil before serving.
